ibs.title: IBS
ibs.text: State and municipal, replaces ICMS and ISS, run by the Managing Committee.

selective.title: Selective tax
selective.text: On goods harmful to health or the environment, from 2027.

splitPayment.title: Split payment
splitPayment.text: The tax is collected when the payment settles, and it moves your cash.

credit.title: Broad credit
credit.text: Financial credit on purchases, when the supplier's tax was paid.

years.y2026: Test year: CBS 0.9% and IBS 0.1% shown on the invoice, offset against PIS/Cofins. Not for Simples.
years.y2027: CBS charged in full, PIS/Cofins abolished, the selective tax starts. IBS at 0.1%.
years.y2028: IBS stays at 0.1% (0.05% state and 0.05% municipal).
years.y2029: ICMS and ISS fall to 9/10 while IBS rises.
years.y2032: ICMS and ISS at 6/10; ICMS benefits compensated until here.
years.y2033: ICMS and ISS abolished. Full IBS and CBS.

readiness.title: Invoice readiness
readiness.heading: Do the clients' invoices already carry IBS/CBS?
readiness.lede: The Presumido and Real clients, by the invoices they issued in the last 30 days: who Franco has to warn before the rejection.
readiness.note: Read from the XMLs imported under Reinaldo › Invoices. An invoice is complete when every item carries the IBS/CBS group, its CST and cClassTrib, and the 2026 test rates. OK at 95% or more with nothing at risk; Attention from 80% to 94%; Critical under 80% or with any invoice at risk of rejection 1115. Simples clients stay out until 2027.

suppliers.heading: How much credit does each client leave on the table?
suppliers.lede: From 2027, buying from Simples suppliers yields little IBS/CBS credit: which clients should review their suppliers.
suppliers.note: Read from the last 90 days' purchase invoices: each supplier's regime comes from the XML's CRT (1, 2 or 4 = Simples/MEI; 3 = standard regime).
